A '''bone-knitter''', also known as a '''bone fuser''',<ref name="Target">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref> or a '''bone welder''',<ref name="Splinter">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> was a medical tool that could repair broken bones.

==Description==
Bone-knitters repaired fractures to bones,<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> and were inserted into a wound to treat the bone.<ref name="Wrath">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref> Tools such as [[Bone stabilizer/Legends|bone stabilizers]] and [[Spray splint/Legends|spray splints]] kept the broken [[Limb/Legends|limb]] immobile and protected until the patient could be taken to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] where a bone-knitter could heal the wound completely.<ref name="EGWT" /> After the bone was treated, it left behind a feeling that was likened to [[Bee/Legends|bee]] stings.<ref name="Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Waywa Fybot]] was treated with a bone-knitter onboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' to repair his broken legs, suffered during an attack on the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] by [[Renatasian]] [[Renatasian Confederation|militants]].<ref name="Flamewind">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>

[[X-7]] used a bone fuser to set his nasal bones in a new configuration after purposely breaking them in order to disguise his face.<ref name="Target" /> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was treated with a bone-knitter to mend his fractured ribs and [[Limb/Legends|leg]] after being captured by [[Moruth Doole]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="JS" />
